verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents dispute/chargeback handling for its general Checkout product ("Crossmint will take on the risk and manage disputes directly with the bank" via an authorization-hold model) and describes network-enforced spend limits for agent cards via Visa/Mastercard rails, but the evidence itself notes this chargeback coverage is documented for general Checkout, not specifically for agent-initiated transactions, and no explicit liability/fraud-responsibility statement exists for agent wallets or agent checkouts. Missing for 10: an explicit merchant-facing liability/fraud-responsibility policy for agent-initiated card and stablecoin transactions, and documentation of chargeback rules specific to agent checkouts (which run on a poll-only, no-staging-environment flow).
